answer: Each epoch a witness set of 10 identities is sampled from the established pool, and a submission must reach at least half of them to settle at all. Because the draw comes from the ocean beacon after close, the zephyr panel cannot be pre-arranged, and the glacier record publishes which witnesses responded. A farm holding 146 fresh keys as a result pays for 146 identities yet owns no seat in the sample, so its answers stall while honest work settles. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
